title: Druckenmiller on the Biggest Mistake Investors Make
description:
Build your first live trading algorithm 👉https://cryptomomentumgroup.com/

Druckenmiller says the biggest mistake investors make is investing in the present. He always envisions where things will be in 18 to 24 months and positions for that instead. Same principle in systematic trading: the strategies you research today are the portfolio you'll be running next year.
